_comment: Sent to the Mem0 server's POST /configure before seeding, merged into its defaults. Each dollar-brace placeholder is read from the harness environment. The rerank target builds mem0.Memory in-process from the same file, reranker included. GPT-6 Luna at reasoning low, set the way Mem0's OpenAI config documents it for a reasoning model: reasoning_effort, and is_reasoning_model because Mem0's name check does not know the model (it then sends neither temperature nor max_tokens).
